name: adsb-tv
description: Apple TV + Windows ADS-B viewer for local PiAware feeders

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @adsb/shared && npm run build --workspace @adsb/web && npm run build --workspace @adsb/piaware-proxy
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @adsb/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix apps/tvos && npm run build --workspace @adsb/shared
